fusions.name: Unseen Cut
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: an unseen edge of wind deals 24 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shaving Breeze
fusions.desc: Shaves a narrow fan of razor air 3 tiles ahead, which deals 4 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge Turned Out
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Next Throat
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
